title: Black Pudding, Egg and Mushroom Breakfast Baps Recipe
ldName: Black pudding, egg and mushroom breakfast baps
ldKeywords: breakfast bap recipes, how to fry eggs, brunch recipes, easy
ldInstructionsRaw: To make the mayo, combine the mayonnaise and the ground chipotle chilli powder
Toast the buns in a pan until golden brown and crisp
Mix together the melted butter and dill, then brush on the toasted buns, reserving some for drizzling
Rub the mushrooms with some oil and then fry in the pan until tender and browned
Fry the rounds of black pudding until crisp and cooked through, then fry the eggs
Spread the mayonnaise on the buns, then top with the mushroom, black pudding and fried eggs. Serve immediately
